title: docs(qa): studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu — the doc app-menu acceptance item, with its first run
body:
Fixes #20939

Clause-②: no

## What this does

Adds `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu` (revision 1, P1, `since: v17.5`) to the platform checklist: the acceptance item objectui#10188 asks for. A `type: 'doc'` app-menu entry follows the reader's audience. The server prunes it from `/meta/app`. The rendered menu mirrors that answer. The reader lands in the book that claims the page. The outsider's direct route renders a refusal, never "not found".

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`: the new item, authored as the review of objectui PR 11258 corrected it (`5919164226` ③ (h)). The UI-mirror clause is scoped to entries naming an installed doc or book, and there is no signed-out persona. `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` and `platform-core.docs-portal-render` stay separate neighbours, cited in `negative` SCOPE and `source`, not merged.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`: the item is mapped under the `doc` and `book` kinds beside those two neighbours. The file is hand-edited; its `$comment` says so and `check-platform-checklist.mjs` only reads it.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: the studio doc-on-menu row's 「清单项待写」 now reads `doc-on-app-menu`. That token is the only change.

### Re-derived from the card's draft

- Dropped the draft's `area` key. No item in the area file carries it.
- `surface` is `mixed`, not `browser`: two clauses use the `api` / `screenshot` oracles.
- Added the traps `stale-console-bundle` (the fork window below) and `cache-staleness`.
- `source` anchors the server half on symbols the gate resolves: `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts#DocNavItemSchema` and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts#filterAppForUser`.
- `since: v17.5`: the `DocNavItemSchema` member and the REST pruning (`bc80e16`) both sit under `## 17.5.0` in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md`.
- The first run added `fixtures.knownGaps` (the fixture recipe it measured, per RUNNER rule 3) and sharpened clause 3's `verify`, as follows. The book sidebar may be narrower than the server tree but never wider. The portal resolves the synthetic Uncategorized group over the book's own package (objectui `apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts` `resolveBookTree`). The server tree's Uncategorized group spans every package.

## First run: the verification record

`QA run · studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu (1/1) · f6ccca4a · 2026-09-30 · 1 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN`

**Env fingerprint**
- Backend: this repository's `main` showcase at `f6ccca4a` (the branch head adds docs only), not a published `@objectstack/cli`. Booted as `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 38741` with `OS_PORT=38741` on a fresh file DB.
- **Fork window.** Pin `.objectui-sha` is `db11afd4967c` (unchanged on `main` at `d7b98176`). The console driven was objectui **`d6a1a80d5d054015097a5dd5dda83737e4b99858`**, the landing commit of objectui PR 11258, which carries PR 11241 (`02fe8ca8a0`). Both are ancestors of it; I checked with `merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0.
- The console was built by `scripts/build-console.sh` with `OBJECTUI_ROOT` at that revision and `.objectui-sha` set to it **in the working tree only**. It was restored afterwards and is not in this diff.
- At the pin, the console source contains no "You do not have access to this documentation" heading and no renderer doc-target check. A run against the vendored pin would fail for a reason that is not this item's.
- The console build needed `npm_config_engine_strict=false`. objectui's `jsdom` test dependency pins Node `^22.22.2` and this container runs `22.22.0`; `jsdom` is not in the console bundle.

**Scope.** Selector `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu`, 1 runnable item, revision 1. There are three personas, each signed in through the form in its own browser context. Each identity was proven with `GET /auth/get-session` before its cells.

**Fixtures.**
- The stock corpus was verified first: one book, `showcase_manual` (audience `public`), 9 docs, and no `doc` nav entry on any app. Everything below was authored at runtime and torn down. Afterwards the corpus reads back as that baseline.
- Writable base `com.qa.docs`, created with `POST /packages`.
- Books, all in `com.qa.docs`: `qa_gated_book` (audience permission set `showcase_auditor`, claims `qa_gated_page`); `qa_open_book` (org, claims `qa_open_page`); `qa_empty_book` (claims nothing). The labels sort `A Empty` / `B Gated` / `C Open`, so "the first book by label" would be the wrong book for both pages.
- App `qa_docs_app`, with seven doc entries covering all three shapes over both corpora.
- Members: a reader holding `showcase_auditor` (through a `sys_user_permission_set` row) and an outsider.
- `qa_gated_page` was authored in the **Studio doc editor**: `PUT …?mode=draft&package=com.qa.docs` 200, then `POST …/publish` 200.

| # | clause | oracle | verdict | evidence (text) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `/meta/app` carries no unreadable doc entry; the reader receives them | api | pass | Reader: all 6 gated and open entries. Outsider: the 3 open entries. Admin (holds no app-declared set): the same 3. `nav_empty_book` (claims no page) is pruned for all three. Same-name reads: reader 200 on `/meta/doc/qa_gated_page` and `/meta/book/qa_gated_book/tree`; outsider 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on both. |
| 1 | UI mirror | dom (after screenshot) | pass | Each shell was screenshotted settled. The rendered doc entries for reader 6, outsider 3 and admin 3 match `/meta/app`. Both diff directions are empty for all three personas. |
| 2 | page opens in its claiming book; book opens on its first readable page with a pruned sidebar | dom | pass | `{doc: qa_open_page}` lands on `/docs/qa_open_book/qa_open_page`, the claiming book, not A/B by label. `{doc: qa_gated_page}` lands on `/docs/qa_gated_book/qa_gated_page`. Both `{book}` entries and both `{book, doc}` entries land on that page. Sidebars: the outsider on the open book sees only `qa_open_page`; the reader sees `qa_open_page, qa_gated_page`. Every sidebar entry is in that member's tree; none is wider. |
| 3 | outsider refused on every direct route; the control reads not found | screenshot | pass | On all 6 gated routes (`/docs/…` and `/apps/qa_docs_app/docs/…` × page / book / book+page): a lock icon, the heading "You do not have access to this documentation", and the server's reason "This documentation is limited to holders of a permission set you do not have". The server answers 403 for the same names. Control `qa_nothing_here` on both route roots shows "Documentation not found"; `GET /meta/doc/qa_nothing_here` answers 404. There was no blank region and no "Failed to load documentation". |

Derived item verdict: **pass**. No `fail`, so there is no reproduction rule to carry. The machine record, in RUNNER shape, is `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/2026-09-30-doc-on-app-menu.json` in the runner's workspace. The `runs/` directory is git-ignored by contract, so it is not in this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- **The run record does not land in the tree, and the `qa-run` issue is not filed by this PR.** `RUNNER.md` and `runs/README.md` make the durable record a text-only GitHub issue labelled `qa-run`. `runs/` tracks only its README. The table above is that record's body, and the title line above follows the canonical five-field shape. Filing it is outside this lane's write budget; the report hands it to the seat.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on one problem that `main` carries too: an `areas/identity-auth.json` `ABSENT SYMBOL` for `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts#twoFactor`. It is identical at `origin/main` `d7b98176`. This diff adds no problem. Before the merge of `main`, the pre-existing `coverage.json · picklist` red also showed; `main` has since cleared it.
- Observation, not filed: once a `{ permissionSet }` book claims a doc, an admin who does not hold that set gets the audience refusal in the Studio editor for the doc they just published. The refusal appears as a banner over a still-"Pending changes" editor. This is the fail-closed audience applied to the author, recorded in the item's knownGaps as a recipe fact.
- Observation, not filed: the server's `GET /meta/book/B/tree` places docs from other packages in B's synthetic Uncategorized group. The portal resolves that group per package. Both read correctly per audience in this run. The divergence belongs to `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` / `docs-portal-render`.

## Gates (after the last commit, head `64cb4e07`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 14 families. All 14 ran, and `--ran` reconciles 14/14 with 0 unrun. Every family exited 0 except `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, which exited 1 on the pre-existing red noted above. Among the named clues, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:nul-bytes` exited 0.

No package changed, so nothing publishes: the PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:测试清单新增一项「菜单上的文档跟着读者的受众走」(`studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu`)。它验收四件事:管理员把文档或文档书挂到应用菜单;有权限的成员看得到、点开落在认领它的那本书里;没权限的成员菜单里看不到;直接敲地址也只看到「无权访问」,而不是「找不到」或白页。北极星里那一行的「清单项待写」换成了这个项 id。

**为什么改**:这是 objectui#10188(裁决批 #206 第 1 项 A:「可能管理员需要在界面上写一些markdown的文档。甚至加到菜单。」)要求的验收项。界面那半已经在 objectui 落地,缺的是一条能反复跑的验收标准,以及第一次真跑的记录。这次按清单实跑了一遍,四条全部通过。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文档和测试清单,不改任何运行时代码,不发布任何包。要注意的是,主仓当前钉住的前端版本(`.objectui-sha`)还不含这批界面改动。本次是用 objectui `d6a1a80d5d` 现编的控制台跑的;在钉版前移之前,拿默认控制台跑这一项会失败,原因不在功能本身。回滚就是还原这三个文件,零副作用。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:本 PR 碰了 `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`(人合档),需要你批准后才能落地。另外,本次的 `qa-run` 运行记录 issue 还没开,由席位代开。
